Overview

Khouribga is a city in Béni Mellal-Khénifra with a population of 196,000. A mining city known as the phosphate capital of the world, with a strong industrial economy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
